what: The read-only paths of the engine, run against the real Codex installation on a Windows 11 machine
what_this_does_not_show: No continuation was sent and no conversation was touched: these are the read paths only.
No thread was loaded at the time, so loaded-state classification of a real held lock was not exercised on this run; only the rule that an absent thread is never called loaded.
Usage was available, so the usage-limit branch was not reached. A usage limit cannot be summoned; docs/LIVE_ACCEPTANCE.md says so and says what to record instead.
One machine, one account, one Codex build.
note: No identifier, path, account or conversation content is recorded here. The usage reason is Codex's own machine-readable string for why the answer is what it is, and carries nothing about the account.
